question: How should Rune combine API, DOM, vision and desktop control while preserving outcome evidence?

sources.title: OpenAI Computer use integration
sources.finding: Custom function/MCP tools and programmatic runtimes can combine DOM locators, text and screenshots. Choose integrations using success, latency, recovery and permissions. This is not a universal API-first mandate or disclosure of all production internals.

sources.title: OpenAI Computer use SDK drivers
sources.finding: Revalidate the original permitted target at execution. Observation does not freeze the UI. Screenshot coordinates and execution must share the same coordinate frame; unsupported operations must not silently succeed.

sources.title: Beyond Browsing: API-Based Web Agents
sources.type: research paper version inspected; first submitted 2024-10-21
sources.finding: API and browsing can provide complementary coverage on WebArena with GPT-4o. API quality, coverage and manual integration matter. This does not establish that APIs always outperform DOM or that private NOL endpoints are authorized.

sources.title: MCPWorld
sources.finding: 201 tasks in instrumented applications compare GUI, MCP and hybrid execution with application-side outcome checks. Missing API coverage motivates hybrid access; additional prompts and switching can also hurt. White-box customized apps differ materially from closed NOL pages.

sources.title: WebChallenger
sources.finding: Section 2.4 reuses PageMem and updates changed sections while retaining unchanged extractions. Appendix D notes hand-designed DOM/workflow heuristics can fail on unusual websites. Supports measuring selective rereads, not assuming a guaranteed speedup.

sources.title: Enhancing Web Agents with a Hierarchical Memory Tree
sources.finding: Separate task/stage/action memory and ground reusable workflows in current UI state. A reported failure from requiring a URL change illustrates why modal progress needs outcome-specific checks. Do not reuse stale selectors as evidence.

decisions: Use a documented authorized API/connector when it covers the requested operation, required fields and the same user/account context. No applicable NOL consumer reservation API was established in this investigation; do not infer that none exists.

Use DOM for NOL's current text/control surface. On missing or stale targets first refresh scoped observations. Consider vision only for genuine visual gaps, with an actual image-capable model and shared page/coordinate state.
Use desktop control for native apps or OS dialogs; prefer accessible element identities where available. Switching drivers does not automatically preserve login, target or transaction identity.
HTTP 403, authentication and access challenges require explicit access handling, not a visual bypass. Unknown write outcomes require independent readback before retrying any mutation.
Persist exact source lines outside model context by run, property, dates, occupancy and room/rate. Keep completed fields; reread stored text first, then obtain only missing evidence.
Gate comparison completion on a fixed structured contract and exact rendered result. Booking requires separate confirmed reservation evidence; comparison success never means booking success.
The new implementation collects DOM evidence only. A universal adaptive API/vision/desktop router is a researched follow-up, not claimed implemented here.

research_harness.limitations: Independent research-agent audit read portions of long papers, not every ablation. Root reviewed primary passages and rejected suggestions to treat access-denial as a visual-fallback trigger. No NOL success claim follows from this research.

evaluation: Track verified required-field coverage, false completion, wrong-target actions, fresh captures versus saved reads, interface-switch reasons, latency and cost. Single live trials cannot establish reliability or causal performance gains.
